name: 风格迁移检测
description: 检测 伪影 from neural style transfer operations applied to images.
algorithm: Neural Style Transfer Artifact Detection via Gram Matrix Divergence
mechanism: Neural style transfer creates characteristic 伪影文本中的ure statistics. This method compares local Gram matrix 特征 跨 patches 以检测 unnaturally uniform texture statistics.
parameters: Feature layers: VGG conv1-5, Gram matrix: per-patch, Divergence: KL, Patch: 64×64 sliding window
source: Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020) — CNN-Generated Images are Surprisingly Easy to Spot... for Now, CVPR
useCase: 识别经过神经风格迁移处理的图像

references.title: Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020) — CNN-Generated Images are Surprisingly Easy to Spot... for Now, CVPR

strengths:
• 检测 NST-specific 伪影
• Works 跨 different style models
• Gram matrix 特征 are discriminative
• Can detect partial style transfer
limitations:
• 可能无法检测细微的风格迁移
• 与艺术滤镜混淆
• 取决于风格迁移方法
• 需要参考风格知识
